component.name: Grimalkin
component.summary: GPU-accelerated terminal emulator with kitty graphics protocol support

description.p: Grimalkin is a GPU-accelerated terminal emulator for Windows, macOS and Linux. It speaks the kitty graphics and keyboard protocols, can wear window skins (including WinAMP skins) and supports color themes with live reload.
It needs a Vulkan capable graphics driver and runs on Wayland or X11.
